|---|---|---|

| **May 28–29** | Berlin | Travel to Berlin on May 28, about 2 hours by train. Spend May 29 sightseeing. |

| **June 7** | Lyon | Take an early train to Lyon, about 2 hours. Explore Vieux Lyon and Fourvière, then enjoy dinner in a traditional bouchon. |
| **June 8–10** | Barcelona | Travel to Barcelona on June 8. A direct train from Lyon takes around 5 hours when operating. Spend June 9–10 exploring Barcelona. |

| **June 16** | Naples | Leave Prague on **June 16** and fly to Naples. Take an evening walk through Naples if arrival time permits. |
| **June 17** | Naples | **Capri day trip:** take a morning ferry to Capri and return to Naples that evening. |
